subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as core TUI config, a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK/rendering seam, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The feature crosses public config, TUI rendering, provider usage/auth calls, and Plugin SDK contracts, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term product boundary.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Use the PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI rendering only after ordering, truncation, caching, and security policy are approved.

options.title: Core TUI config template
options.body: Add a first-class `tui` footer template/config surface and accept the migration and compatibility burden of a new public config contract.

options.title: Keep existing status surfaces
options.body: Leave `/status`, `/usage`, CLI status, and menu-bar usage as the supported quota/cost surfaces and reject persistent footer customization for now.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Use the PluginStatusProvider direction as the extension boundary, then add TUI rendering only after ordering, truncation, caching, and security policy are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main routing candidate for the intersecting TUI footer, provider-usage/status, and config surfaces.
